rationale: The pain is real but extremely narrow: a single forum post from a user puzzling over a specific Azure AI Foundry billing footnote. No adjacent threads, no competitor tools targeting this niche, and no willingness-to-pay signal beyond the implicit fact the user is an Azure customer. The addressable population of engineers simultaneously evaluating Azure AI Gateway pricing and in market for a third-party explainer tool is too small and too transient to clear the evidence bar; the moment Azure clarifies its docs, the opportunity evaporates.
